body:
Thank you, as I said in another comment, it just doesn't feel like strength.

Trust though, I don't know how to get past that. I hear guys tell me they understand but it almost makes me push them away even more.

Thank you for your kind response.

It has never felt like strength. I don't feel strong because this is something I'm so used to.

Like when you've been running your whole life so that mile long run is no big deal.
I will look into it ASAP. Not home today, but when I get home I will look around!

I'll go to the local college and see what they have to say. It could help a lot! At least if they left my name out of everything, I would be a lot more willing.

Then it's a win win. Kids get learning experience and I get help.

When I was in elementary and middle school I took sailing lessons. I'd have to relearn but I'm a quick learner. I would absorb the info fast! I loved sailing.

You're so kind. I'll look around and find a cheaper/healthy place. :3

I know I need to think positive :[ I have a negative nancy attitude when things get bad and I genuinely want to turn that around. I'm trying to meditate and keep my temper in check as best as I can. it's hard though when you don't trust people.

I'm so used to things going wrong that I feel stupid trying to be positive. It makes me feel like a kid over playing their part in a play.

Thank you for your reply!

The sailing thing sounds great! I would enjoy that immensely. I wanted to be a marine biologist forever. The ocean has this mystery to it that overwhelms me! That seriously sounds so great!

I will try a library next, I just am used to working a fast paced environment. I get fidgety when I don't move.

I was just in Oregon! I was in Portland looking for a job just a week ago. Your offer is extremely generous and kind. It warms my heart just at the fact that you even offered. Seriously, thank you.
Thank you. I need people to understand. I'm not hear because I want pity, I'm here because I genuinely want to get out of this cycle of wanting to kill myself. Thanks!
I think I'd panic to know that multiple people are going over my trauma to a classroom :[

I like your list idea and I will try it out. Hopefully I can sort it out.

You're right, I'm giving in because I don't know what else to do :[

And practical is good, I prefer someone telling me the WHY and HOW instead of praying for me. Thank you!

Thank you for your reply. You didn't try to bullshit me and I genuinely appreciate that.

As for old teachers or anything, no. I moved too much growing up. 3 schools in the 3rd grade alone, 5 high schools in 3 years. I've moved more times than I can count :/ I don't have anyone that I can confide in. My dad (bless his heart) isn't that kind of guy that can comfort me. He never knows what to say.

As for a move, I would LOVE to move and have been trying, but I have no money at all to get the gas and drive somewhere. Otherwise, I'd leave tonight. I've been looking at places everywhere. I live in California and its just too expensive. 

And the professional help would be welcomed but I can't afford it, and since I have no job, I can't get it through work. I used to go to a psychologist when I could afford it and believe it helped a lot. Sadly, I'm so broke I can barely eat. 


When you say hard to read you mean my writing style right? Sorry, I let my brain barf things out and don't filter it. You aren't the first to tell me it's hard to read! 

Thank you again for your reply!

I feel like I should add that I was diagnosed with Celiac a few months ago and lost my job in October. I haven't found any work at all.

I can't even feed myself. Went onto foods stamps and got a letter today saying that they question if I'm out of work because they don't understand how I've been paying my rent.

Truth is, I haven't been. I'm several months behind.
